provenance.section: Protocol — "The WebSocket feed uses a bidirectional protocol that encodes all messages as JSON objects."
modifications: There is no documented Coinbase frame that is not JSON, so this fixture has no documented basis and is labelled accordingly. It exists because ADR-004 §1 records that other feeds in this repository DO send bare text frames (Polymarket's PING/PONG), and because a parser must have a defined answer for a frame the venue should never send.

expectation: Classified REJECTED/NOT_JSON. Produces a COINBASE_FRAME_NOT_JSON anomaly carrying the text verbatim, so the caller can hand the same bytes to the WAL and to a data-quality incident. It is never dropped, and it never throws out of the read loop.
